definitions.gloss: approximate number; rough figure; round number
definitions.explanation: A number that is not exact but gives a general idea of the quantity. Used in mathematics education, statistics, and everyday reporting when precise figures are unnecessary or unavailable.

examples.japanese: {概数|がいすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Give your answer as an approximate number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{概数|がいすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三百人|さんびゃくにん}ほどだった。
examples.english: The number of participants was roughly three hundred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{概数|がいすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求|もと}め→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to calculate approximate numbers in elementary school math.

notes:
Compound of {概|がい} (approximate; general) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). Taught as a formal mathematical concept in Japanese elementary school (typically 4th grade), where students learn rounding (⟦{四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}→四捨五入：15694_shishagonyuu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概数|がいすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express as an approximate number
- {概数|がいすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to answer with a rough figure
- {概数|がいすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求|もと}め→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: how to calculate approximate numbers
- {概数|がいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use approximate numbers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧: approximately — prefix for approximate quantities; more casual (⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧)
- おおよそ: roughly; approximately — adverb used conversationally
- ⟦{四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}→四捨五入：15694_shishagonyuu⟧: rounding (off) — the specific method of rounding to the nearest value
- ⟦{端数|はすう}→端数：23501_hasuu⟧: fraction; odd amount — the remainder that gets dropped when rounding
